ticks.note: `A` and `B` in tick 1. Entering `ABO` sets `gotA` and `gotB` to false; then the immediate transitions see `A` and `B` and set both flags, and `Emit`, which reads the flags after they are written, emits `O` in this same tick.
All three regions rest. No region has a final state and nothing terminates, so there is no join to lose.
`R` re-enters `ABO`: the flags start again at false.
`B`: `gotB` is set, and `Emit` sees both flags: `O`.
`R`, `A` and `B` together: `ABO` is re-entered and, in its entry tick, all three immediate transitions fire. `O` is present, as the immediate ABRO intends.
`R` still works: the chart did not get stuck.
